# --- TRUST-ROOT EXCEPTION (2026-07-09) ---
# The official Go toolchain distributed via golang.org/toolchain (sum-verified
# against sum.golang.org) is the root of trust, not a third-party worm vector,
# so the fortnight rule does not apply. Needed because dMon runs go1.26.4 while
# repos require go1.26.5 (GOTOOLCHAIN=auto fetches the toolchain as a module).
# Published 2026-07-01. Bump deliberately per Go version.
golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.26.5.linux-amd64
golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.26.5.linux-arm64

# --- govulncheck BOOTSTRAP (2026-09-01) ---
# Operator-approved this session. The go-gate vet classifier had NO vulnerability
# coverage on this host: govulncheck was not installed, so every report carried
# "vulnerability scan SKIPPED" and every verdict auto-downgraded to flag (per
# spec: never a silent pass on missing coverage). Installing it needs
# golang.org/x/vuln in the ledger, which needed a vet — the bootstrap paradox.
# This entry breaks that cycle so all later vets carry real CVE data.
#
# Vetted with go-gate vet; reports in reports/. x/mod, x/sync, x/sys, x/telemetry
# and x/tools are one-step bumps whose capabilities are IDENTICAL to the versions
# already allowed above. x/vuln@v1.7.0 is new to the ledger: capabilities exec +
# network, which are inherent to the tool (execs the Go toolchain to build the
# package graph; fetches the vuln DB, by default from https://vuln.go.dev — point
# at a local mirror with -db if that egress is unwanted). No typosquat, no known
# vulns. Older x/vuln releases were checked and need the same 5 deps, so the
# latest was taken.
#
# NOTE: this set was necessarily vetted WITHOUT vulnerability scanning — it is
# the scanner. Capability analysis only; that is inherent to bootstrapping.
golang.org/x/mod@v0.39.0
golang.org/x/sync@v0.22.0
golang.org/x/sys@v0.47.0
golang.org/x/telemetry@v0.0.0-20260811182544-a038080d80e5
golang.org/x/tools@v0.49.0
golang.org/x/vuln@v1.7.0

# --- 2026-10-12: October Go security advisories (nexus #512) ---
# golang.org/x/net v0.58.0 carries GO-2026-6603/6610/6611/6612/6617, fixed in
# v0.60.0 (published 2026-10-08, inside the fortnight). Operator approved the
# security fix over the freshness window. go-gate vet: FLAG on capabilities
# only (cgo/exec/go:linkname/init/unsafe) — the IDENTICAL set to the already-
# trusted v0.58.0; govulncheck clean; no typosquat. Its deps x/sys, x/term,
# x/text move one minor each; capability sets identical to their predecessors,
# govulncheck clean (x/text's "typosquat" is golang.org/x/net itself, a false
# positive). Reports in reports/.
golang.org/x/net@v0.60.0
golang.org/x/sys@v0.48.0
golang.org/x/term@v0.46.0
golang.org/x/text@v0.42.0
# Trust-root exception (official Go release, sum-verified): go1.26.9 fixes the
# go1.26.6 stdlib advisories GO-2026-6599..6613 (net/http, crypto/tls,
# net/textproto, html/template).
golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.26.9.linux-amd64
